agentSetup.title: Connecting a Coding Agent
agentSetup.subtitle: Public documentation wiki at /wiki. MCP: use the tymio-mcp CLI on the OpenClaw gateway (stdio), or a remote URL in Cursor, Claude Code, and similar.
agentSetup.wikiLinkDesc: Step-by-step guides for humans and agents (MCP overview, OpenClaw, OAuth). Raw Markdown is also at /wiki/articles/*.md on this host.
agentSetup.sectionIntro: Tymio exposes MCP with OAuth. Root /mcp is discovery-only (list workspaces + routing help). Full backlog tools require /t/<workspace-slug>/mcp. For stdio, set TYMIO_MCP_URL or tymio-mcp login to a workspace URL. For Cursor and remote Streamable HTTP, prefer the URL below when you open this page inside a workspace. No per-user MCP API key in Settings.
agentSetup.remoteLeadWorkspace: The URL below pins this workspace. After OAuth you get the full MCP tool surface (initiatives, features, requirements, atlas, briefs). Sign in with Google when you connect — no API keys.
agentSetup.remoteLeadNoWorkspace: The URL below is origin + /mcp — discovery only (OAuth, list your workspaces, routing guide). It does not run backlog tools. Open this page from inside a workspace to copy /t/<workspace-slug>/mcp, or connect here first and use tool tymio_list_my_workspaces to list workspace URLs.
agentSetup.step1Hint: For example: Cursor → Settings → MCP, or your tool's integrations panel.
agentSetup.step2Hint: Create a new entry (you can name it "tymio" or similar).
agentSetup.step3: Set the transport to remote and use this URL
agentSetup.step4Desc: Your tool opens a browser. Sign in to Tymio and approve access. You are redirected back and the session stays tied to your user — same roles as the web app.
agentSetup.remoteTransportNote: (Streamable HTTP; some UIs may also mention SSE)
agentSetup.stdioTitle: Option 1 — Stdio CLI from npm (recommended for OpenClaw)
agentSetup.stdioLead: For gateways that run MCP as a subprocess — including OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and other CLI-first agents. Install @tymio/mcp-server, run tymio-mcp login once, then register tymio-mcp in your MCP config.
agentSetup.stdioStep1: Install the CLI from the public npm registry:
agentSetup.stdioStep2: In a terminal, sign in once (opens your browser for Google):
agentSetup.stdioStep3: In your agent’s MCP configuration, add a stdio server that runs tymio-mcp. Set TYMIO_MCP_URL (or run tymio-mcp login) to https://<host>/t/<workspace-slug>/mcp for full backlog tools; root …/mcp is discovery-only. Leave TYMIO_API_KEY and API_KEY unset (legacy DRD_API_KEY) unless you deliberately want the smaller REST-based tool set (deployment secret, not a user setting).
agentSetup.stdioStep4Label: Example configuration (Cursor-style JSON; OpenClaw uses mcp.servers — see OpenClaw box below):
agentSetup.openclawHint: On the machine running the OpenClaw gateway, register the stdio server, then restart the gateway:
agentSetup.stdioPathHint: If tymio-mcp is not on your PATH, use node with the full path to dist/index.js inside the installed package.
agentSetup.stdioFooterLead: Full README, environment variables, and troubleshooting:
agentSetup.stdioFooterCli: Print the long agent-oriented guide in a terminal:
agentSetup.securityDesc: Connections use OAuth with PKCE and refresh-token rotation. Reused or stolen tokens can be revoked; your workspace is not accessed via a shared password pasted into Settings.
agentSetup.oauthNotApiKeyBody: There is no personal "MCP API key" in Tymio Settings, Profile, or Account. Do not tell people to copy one from the UI. Use OAuth: either the remote URL above or npm install -g @tymio/mcp-server and tymio-mcp login. TYMIO_API_KEY / API_KEY on a machine (legacy DRD_API_KEY) refers to a deployment automation secret, not an end-user field.

admin.ontology.desc: Product capabilities, bindings to routes/MCP/models, and the compiled agent brief. Use “Refresh defaults” to seed from the codebase manifest; edit semantics here.
admin.ontology.title: Title
admin.ontology.tenantGuideBindingsBody:
Use backlog fields for row-level links: initiative notes, feature description, requirement external reference. Add FIGMA_NODE or DESIGN_REF here when you want the same design anchor on the capability itself so it appears in the compiled agent brief next to routes and MCP tools. After edits, use “Compile & store briefs” above.

Full tenant playbook: docs/DESIGN_REFERENCES.md in the repository.
admin.ontology.tenantGuideBindingsExamples:
FIGMA_NODE — key: fileKey:1:234 (from figma.com/design/<fileKey>/… ; take node-id from the URL and replace hyphens with colons).
DESIGN_REF — key: full https://… URL or a short stable id your team documents.

admin.noRules: No notification rules. Add one to notify users on events.
admin.exportFailed: Export failed. Check the console for details.
admin.importFailed: Import failed. Transaction was rolled back. No data was changed.
admin.clearFailed: Clear failed. Transaction was rolled back.
